questions.q: What question does Dawkins use to illustrate the problem of an ultimate designer?
a: What is the purpose of prayer?
questions.why: Dawkins asks who created God to show infinite regress.

questions.q: According to Dawkins, religion is best described as what evolutionary by-product?
a: A meme that spread with obedience to authority
questions.why: He calls religion a successful meme linked to obedience.

questions.q: What does Dawkins claim science can replace without losing moral benefits?
questions.why: He argues science can substitute religion while keeping moral comfort.

questions.q: How many of Dawkins' arguments against God's existence are based on common sense?
questions.why: Two of his three arguments rely on common‑sense reasoning.

questions.q: What earlier work introduced Dawkins' idea of selfish genes?
questions.why: His earlier seminal book is The Selfish Gene.
